searchText: The addresses would be 42 chars, but they would "look different". eg. something like `e[chainid]-[epoch and other metadata]-[26 bytes in base64 format]` With that format, aren't there possible new-style addresses interpretable as old-style (and vice versa)? E.g. `e000...`, or anything matching `e[0-9a-f]{41}` old style would always have 0x prefix, no? Ah right, I was thinking the part _after_ the 0x was 42 characters, but it's 42 including that 0x. Is there a risk of applications/naive implementations taking `input[2:]` (if input length = 42), and that being valid in both old/new style in some cases?
